full_judgment:
Mr. Muhammad Imman Ali, J: This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against the Judgment and Order dated 22.01.2013 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.4628 of 2013 discharging the Rule. 

 2. The relevant facts, for disposal of the case, are that the petitioner as informant lodged F.I.R. in Mongla Police Station against the accused opposite party alleging inter alia that the accused took loan of Tk. 2,82,000/- on different dates from between 03.03.1995 to 03.03.1998 and the accused being a Manager, Rupali Bank Limited, Mongla Branch assured the informant also kept 6 signed, undated cheques with the accused, who failed to sanction the promised loan in favour of the informant, but refused to return back the said six cheques or Tk. 2,82,000/- and such the First Information Report was lodged. 

 3. The police after investigation submitted charge sheet against the accused opposite party under Sections 406/420 of the Penal Code on 19.02.2008. On the date of framing charge the accused person filed an application under Section 241A of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The learned Magistrate by the order dated 02.03.2009 allowed the petition and discharged the accused opposite party No.1 from the case. Against the order, the informant preferred the Criminal Revision No.63 of 2009 before the Sessions Judge, Bagerhat and the said revision was sent to the Second Court of Additional Sessions Judge, Bagerhat for disposal, who after hearing by his judgment and order dated 25.05.2011 rejected the Revisional application. 

 4. Being aggrieved by the judgment and order passed by the Additional Sessions Judge the informant filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.4628 of 2013 under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the High Court Division and obtained Rule. By the impugned judgment and order, the High Court Division discharged the Rule. Hence, the petitioner has filed the instant Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal before this Division.
